## Biography

An orange star. Ships on landing pads. A Trailblazer Megaship swallowing vessels whole and spitting them back out as expedition-ready hulls.

The Collinder 285 Sector served as the operational headquarters for Distant Worlds 3 planning in 3311. Here, Hermine Delarue met with Cal in her Deep Space Surveys office, negotiating his reluctant recruitment over Lavian Brandy. Here, John Ermitage — brought out of semi-stasis for the occasion — directed the expedition's route toward Orion, rejecting the overcrowded space bars of Pallaeni in favor of something more ambitious. The sector is unremarkable on charts. Its significance is entirely human: a room where three people decided to point ten thousand pilots at the dark and see what answered.
